title: ChartEvo: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses for Long-Tail Chart Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28282v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced chart understanding and reasoning, yet their performance remains highly uneven across chart types. While modern MLLMs perform well on common charts, their accuracy drops sharply on long-tail charts with diverse visual structures and reasoning requirements. Tool-augmented agents can improve complex chart reasoning by introducing specialized visual capabilities, but manually engineering strategies and tools for the heterogeneous and evolving long tail is difficult to scale. We introduce \textbf{ChartEvo}, a recursive self-improvement framework that enables chart agents to adapt to underperforming chart types through experience-driven harness-level self-improvement. ChartEvo jointly evolves reusable chart-specific Skills and executable Tools, while learning reusable local tool-call chains to compose evolved capabilities and control the inference overhead of tool-augmented

translated_title: ChartEvo：面向长尾图表推理的自进化智能体框架
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在图表理解与推理方面取得了显著进展，但其在不同图表类型上的表现仍然很不均衡。尽管现代MLLM在常见图表上表现良好，但在具有多样化视觉结构和推理需求的长尾图表上，其准确率会急剧下降。工具增强型智能体可以通过引入专门的视觉能力来改进复杂图表推理，但为异构且不断演进的长尾图表手动设计策略和工具难以规模化。我们提出了ChartEvo，这是一个递归自我改进框架，使图表智能体能够通过经验驱动的框架级自我改进来适应表现不佳的图表类型。ChartEvo共同进化可复用的图表特定技能和可执行工具，同时学习可复用的局部工具调用链，以组合已进化的能力并控制工具增强推理的开销。
tldr: ChartEvo提出了一种递归自我改进框架，通过经验驱动地共同进化图表专用技能与可执行工具，并学习可复用的局部工具调用链，使图表智能体能够自适应地提升在长尾图表上的推理能力，同时控制推理开销。
en_tdlr: ChartEvo is a recursive self-improvement framework that enables chart agents to adapt to long-tail chart reasoning by jointly evolving reusable chart-specific skills and executable tools while learning local tool-call chains to compose capabilities and control inference overhead.
